prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent hero instrument for Ferrigura, a Rust renderer that lays out Mermaid diagrams and produces SVG without a browser. A functional physical metaphor, rendered in the Ferra precision-mechanical family style.
Create an elegant mechanical diagram-layout fixture: three broad satin-steel rectangular diagram nodes and one restrained rust-brown copper-oxide decision diamond arranged in a coherent, generously spaced flowchart. Substantial open graphite right-angle connector rails link the nodes; small precision sliding collars at two connections express layout and alignment. All broad node faces remain blank. The diagram is the object itself, with open negative space instead of a background board. This is a single diagram rendering instrument, never a family pipeline.
Materials and light: matte pewter and finely brushed satin steel, warm charcoal graphite recesses and edges, only the decision diamond in copper oxide. Warm diffuse studio illumination from upper left, crisp realistic metal bevels, precise clean craft. No chrome, glossy plastic, wood, distressed rust, neon, orange glow, decoration or heavy forge motifs.
Camera and composition: shallow three-quarter view from slightly above, landscape about 2:1, complete instrument centered with generous clear padding, no clipping. The open metal graph occupies most of the width. No text, letters, logos, tiny ruler ticks, numbers, interface or watermark.
Genuine transparent background, including all spaces between nodes and connector rails. No opaque white or black backdrop, floor, enclosing base slab, app tile, badge or presentation board. Output only the original reusable instrument asset.
